sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation expansion for original hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy insect game. Reference images are identity and style references only, NOT desired grid or background. Preserve exact character identity, proportions, costume, palette, clean ink and painterly material textures. Pure side view all living frames facing RIGHT. Transparent real alpha background, no backdrop, ground, shadows, labels, text, borders, particles, panels. Each equal cell contains exactly one COMPLETE character including every antenna, blade and robe, with ample transparent gutter. Fixed body scale and centered pelvis, grounded foot baseline at 90% cell height. Distinct redrawn poses with real limb and weapon articulation, never stamp, shift or rotate a whole copy. Character: Copperroot Bishop exactly reference, bark armored bulky beetle priest with tall carved wooden mitre, black face and glowing ivory eye, dark leaf-green cloak and ivory woven stole, living crooked root crozier decorated amber acorns and tiny leaves. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS by NINE ROWS = 36 sprites on TALL canvas. Characters SMALL with vast transparent padding, no sprite larger than 65% cell width or 70% cell height. ROWS 1 idle 4 frames; rows2 and3 eight walking frames alternating foot/arm positions; row4 four windup gradually raise root crozier; row5 four strike/sweep crozier full weapon motion; row6 four recovery easing staff back to ground; row7 four hurt poses, recoil head/torso/legs; row8 four death progression stagger/kneel/falling/collapsed; row9 four additional attack followthrough and recover poses. Every frame character complete, including FULL crozier despite widest reach. Same scale all frames, orthographic side view faces right, fully transparent alpha, no brown or green scene or background and no shadows.
